conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces portfolio risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of broad index and quality tech.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-beta tech, which can lead to substantial gains but also much larger drawdowns. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects on leveraged ETFs, and maintain strict stop discipline.

plan: Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced income.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates heavily into income-generating ETFs and cuts nearly all leveraged and high-beta single names. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market downturns; this is not a savings account.
